title: "Okular"

## Install Okular

Okular is the managed document and PDF viewer. It supports PDF viewing,
annotations, bookmarks and document navigation, PDF forms, and a broader range
of document formats useful in academic reading and review workflows.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags okular
```

The role installs Okular and the default-applications role makes it the preferred
viewer for PDF files.

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
okular --version
xdg-mime query default application/pdf
```

The MIME query should return `org.kde.okular.desktop`.
:::
